thread:
mina: Hey team, escalating a customer issue. They tried to use streaming with the /v1/rerank endpoint and got a 415 / 400 depending on attempt. customer-abc pasted logs.
laura-cs: Customer says they switched from a text-generation SSE flow and tried to reuse it for rerank. They hit errors and also saw unexpected scores (all 0.0).
mina: Logged repro steps from the customer below, copying request-id: rq_3f2b9. Please help triage, assigning to eng-runtime if needed.
customer-abc: repro steps:

1) attempt to stream with curl (they used SSE):
```
curl -v -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED"
  -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream"
  --data-binary $'\n{"query":"Find the best doc","candidates":["doc a","doc b"]}\n'
```
response: HTTP/1.1 415 Unsupported Media Type
{"error":"rerank does not support streaming. Use application/json POST with full payload."}
```

customer-abc: Then they tried chunked encoding with Transfer-Encoding: chunked and got a 400 and no scores.

```
> POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
Content-Type: application/json

1a
{"query":"x","candidates":[]}
0
```
server log snippet they sent:
```
ERROR [req=rq_3f2b9] runtime: unsupported content-type 'text/event-stream' at input parser
WARN  [req=rq_3f2b9] rerank: empty candidate list after parse -> returning empty scores
```

mina: Repro attached. The customer is on paid hosted plan, wants a fast fix. They attempted the streaming route because they thought it would lower latency for many candidates.
laura-cs: Customer asks if rerank supports streaming at all or partial results. Also worried about billing because they retried many times.
billing-bot: FYI: multiple failed attempts flagged; no charges applied for 4xx/415 but retry volume could hit rate limits. Please confirm before telling customer.
samir: @mina thanks for the details. Rerank endpoint is not a streaming endpoint — it expects a single JSON POST with the full candidate array and returns a full scores array. We'll need to confirm error code semantics; 415 is OK for wrong content-type, 400 for malformed chunked bodies.
kai: Adding notes: We also have strict limits on candidates and payload size (default 2048 tokens across query+candidates). If they chunked, our parser might see incomplete JSON which leads to empty candidate parse -> zero scores.
mina: Quick suggested reply to customer: ask them to POST application/json, ensure candidates is an array of strings/objects, and not stream. Provide sample curl and max limits.
mina: Proposed repro curl (non-streaming):
```
curl -v "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"query":"Find the best doc","candidates":["doc a","doc b"]}'
```
response should be 200 with body like:
```
{"scores":[0.72,0.28],"model":"re-rank-v1","request_id":"rq_3f2b9"}
```
laura-cs: I'll send that and include the limits and a quick checklist: content-type, no chunked encoding, candidates format, token budget.
mina: @samir can you confirm whether we can return a clearer error message (instead of empty/zero scores) when parsing fails? The customer was confused by 0.0 scores and thought model was broken.
samir: We should. The parser currently swallows malformed candidate arrays and returns zero-length scores in some code paths. I'll file a quickticket and add a guard to return 400 + structured error like {"error":"invalid candidates format"}. Will need eng-runtime to deploy a small change. Logging improvement too.
ops-oncall: @samir please add request_id in all error paths; makes debugging easier. We should also detect text/event-stream and return 415 with suggested header in body.
samir: Will do. ETA for patch: 1 business day for guard + tests, 2 days to roll on prod if no surprises. If customer needs hotfix, we can prioritize.
mina: Customer also mentioned they expect streaming because they have 1000s candidates but only need topK streaming. We should surface design guidance: use candidate pre-filtering, or do batched reranks and early-stopping clientside. @product might want to consider async/topK streaming API in roadmap.
laura-cs: Noted, I'll add product ask. For now I'll provide workaround: chunk candidates client-side into batches of 64, call rerank repeatedly and client-side merge top-k.
customer-abc: thanks, can you confirm if any billing happened? I retried ~120 times.
billing-bot: No charges for 4xx/415 responses. If subsequent retries succeeded, those calls billed. I'll DM support with exact count.
mina: OK I'll send the reply, include repro fix, link to candidate format in docs, and ask if they'd like us to escalate for hotfix.
laura-cs: Sending now. If customer reports 200 with scores after switching to application/json then close. If they still see zeros, collect request_id and paste here.
customer-abc: quick follow-up, when I switched to application/json I got 200 but scores were all 0.0 — request_id rq_3f2b9.

mina: @samir raising a follow-up: they switched CT and still got zeros. Based on server log earlier, parser warned about "empty candidate list after parse". Possible payload mismatch (they might be sending nested objects not strings). Samir can you pull the raw request payload from logs for rq_3f2b9?
samir: Pulling now. Raw payload shows candidates: [{"text":"doc a"},{"text":"doc b"}] while our rerank expects candidates: ["doc a","doc b"] or objects with "content" field depending on model version. We'll add parser compatibility and better error.
mina: Great catch. I'll update customer that they used objects with "text" so explain accepted shapes and give example.
laura-cs: Customer replied happy after fix (converted payload) and got sensible scores. Closing once billing confirms no unexpected charges. :tada:

mina: Follow-ups: eng-runtime to add better 415 message + candidate format errors, docs to include clear non-streaming warning on rerank, product to consider top-K streaming API. Thanks everyone.
